title: कोशीमा हिक्मतलाई हटाउन एमालेभित्रै फेरि चलखेल, असन्तुष्ट सांसदहरूले ओलीलाई भेट्दै
content:
No ads found for this position विराटनगर । कोशी प्रदेश सरकारको मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्न नेकपा एमालेभित्रै फेरि चलखेल सुरू भएको छ । मुख्यमन्त्री हिक्मतकुमार कार्कीको स्थानमा तिलकुमार मेन्याङ्बोलाई मुख्यमन्त्री बनाउन एमालेकै असन्तुष्ट प्रदेशसभा सदस्यहरूले दबाब दिन थालेका हुन् । मुख्यमन्त्री कार्की एमाले सचिव तथा कोशी प्रदेश संसदीय दलका नेता हुन् भने मेन्याङ्बो दलका उपनेता हुन् । दलका नेताको स्थानमा उपनेताको नेतृत्वमा सरकार गठन गर्ने विषयमा पार्टी अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओलीसँग समेत कुराकानी भइसकेको छ । मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषयमा दबाब बढाउन असन्तुष्ट सांसदहरूले आज पार्टी अध्यक्ष ओलीलाई भेट्ने तयारी गरेका छन् । पूर्वमन्त्रीसमेत रहेका प्रदेशसभा सदस्य एकराज कार्कीले अध्यक्ष ओलीसँग भेट्न समय मागिएको जानकारी दिँदै कोशीको समसामयिक विषयमा कुराकानी गरिने बताए । यसअघि असन्तुष्ट प्रदेशसभा सदस्यहरूले मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषयमा पार्टीका कोशी प्रदेश अध्यक्ष घनश्याम खतिवडा र प्रदेश इन्चार्ज शेरधन राईसमक्ष दबाब बढाएपछि उनीहरूले अध्यक्ष ओलीसँग यसै विषयमा संवाद गरेका थिए । भेटमा अध्यक्ष ओलीले यसअघिको वाचाअनुसार मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले सहज अवतरण गरिदिनुपर्ने बताएका थिए । भेटमा सहभागी एक नेताले अध्यक्ष ओलीलाई उद्धृत गर्दै भने, ‘हिक्मतजीले यसअघि नै मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्छु भनेकाले उहाँले बाटो खोलिदिनुहुन्छ । उहाँले गर्नुभएन भने म कुरा गर्छु ।’ तर, कहिलेसम्ममा मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्ने भन्ने समयसीमाबारे भने अध्यक्ष ओलीले केही नखुलाएको ती नेताले बताए । अध्यक्ष ओली र मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीबीच कुराकानी भएपछि मात्र यस विषयमा थप स्पष्ट हुने उनको भनाइ छ । नेकपा एमाले र नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (नेकपा) बिच प्रदेशहरूमा सत्ता साझेदारी गर्ने सहमति हुनुअघि नै गएको साउनमा कोशीका एमाले सांसदहरूले मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीविरुद्ध हस्ताक्षर अभियान सञ्चालन गरेका थिए । कार्कीविरुद्ध बहुमत पुर्‍याएर दलको नेताबाट हटाए पनि संविधानको धारा १६८ (५) अन्तर्गत गठन भएको सरकार भएकाले मुख्यमन्त्रीको पद नजाने अवस्था देखिएपछि उक्त विषय पार्टी नेतृत्वसमक्ष पुगेको थियो । मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले राजीनामा नदिएसम्म नयाँ मुख्यमन्त्री बन्न नसक्ने भएपछि सो विषय टुङ्गो लगाउन अध्यक्ष ओली, एमाले कोशी नेतृत्व र मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीबिच छलफल भएको थियो । उक्त छलफलमा मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले उपयुक्त समय आएपछि आफूले मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्ने बताएका थिए । अहिले असन्तुष्ट सांसदहरूले उपयुक्त समय आइसकेको भन्दै मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले राजीनामा दिनुपर्ने माग गरेका छन् । कोशीमा हाल एमाले र नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टीबिच सत्ता समीकरण छ । कांग्रेससँगको सत्ता समीकरण सकिएपछि मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषय केही समय सामसुम भएको भए पनि अहिले पुनः बल्झिएको हो । Biratnagar. The movement to change the Chief Minister of the Koshi Province government has begun again within the CPN-UML. Dissatisfied members of the UML's provincial assembly have started pressuring Til Kumar Menyangbo to replace Chief Minister Hikmat Kumar Karki. Chief Minister Karki is the UML secretary and leader of the Koshi Province parliamentary party, while Menyangbo is the deputy leader of the party. Discussions have also been held with party chairman KP Sharma Oli regarding forming a government under the leadership of the deputy leader in place of the party leader. Dissatisfied lawmakers are preparing to meet party chairman Oli today to increase pressure on changing the Chief Minister. Ekraj Karki, a member of the Provincial Assembly and a former minister, informed that he has requested time to meet Chairman Oli and said that they will discuss current issues in Koshi. Earlier, after disgruntled provincial assembly members increased pressure on the party's Koshi Province President Ghanshyam Khatiwada and Province In-charge Sherdhan Rai to change the Chief Minister, they had held talks with Chairman Oli on the issue. During the meeting, Chairman Oli had said that Chief Minister Karki should make a smooth landing as promised earlier. A leader who participated in the meeting quoted Chairman Oli as saying, "Hikmatji has already said he will pave the way, so he will pave the way. If he doesn't, I will talk." However, the leader said that Chairman Oli has not revealed anything about the timeframe for paving the road. He said that more clarity on this issue will be available only after a conversation between Chairman Oli and Chief Minister Karki. Even before the agreement to share power in the provinces between the CPN-UML and the Nepali Communist Party (NCP), Koshi's UML lawmakers had launched a signature campaign against Chief Minister Karki in July. Even after a majority vote against Karki and his removal as party leader, the issue reached the party leadership after it became apparent that the Chief Minister's post would not be taken up as the government was formed under Article 168 (5) of the Constitution. Since Chief Minister Karki could not become the new Chief Minister unless he resigned, a discussion was held between Chairman Oli, UML Koshi leadership and Chief Minister Karki to resolve the issue. During the discussion, Chief Minister Karki had said that he would pave the way when the right time came. Now, disgruntled MPs have demanded that Chief Minister Karki resign, saying that the right time has come. There is currently a power equation between the UML and the Nepali Communist Party in Koshi . Although the issue of changing the Chief Minister was moot for some time after the power equation with the Congress ended, it has now resurfaced.

The movement to change the Chief Minister of the Koshi Province government has begun again within the CPN-UML. Dissatisfied members of the UML's provincial assembly have started pressuring Til Kumar Menyangbo to replace Chief Minister Hikmat Kumar Karki. Chief Minister Karki is the UML secretary and leader of the Koshi Province parliamentary party, while Menyangbo is the deputy leader of the party. Discussions have also been held with party chairman KP Sharma Oli regarding forming a government under the leadership of the deputy leader in place of the party leader. Dissatisfied lawmakers are preparing to meet party chairman Oli today to increase pressure on changing the Chief Minister. Ekraj Karki, a member of the Provincial Assembly and a former minister, informed that he has requested time to meet Chairman Oli and said that they will discuss current issues in Koshi. Earlier, after disgruntled provincial assembly members increased pressure on the party's Koshi Province President Ghanshyam Khatiwada and Province In-charge Sherdhan Rai to change the Chief Minister, they had held talks with Chairman Oli on the issue. During the meeting, Chairman Oli had said that Chief Minister Karki should make a smooth landing as promised earlier. A leader who participated in the meeting quoted Chairman Oli as saying, "Hikmatji has already said he will pave the way, so he will pave the way. If he doesn't, I will talk." However, the leader said that Chairman Oli has not revealed anything about the timeframe for paving the road. He said that more clarity on this issue will be available only after a conversation between Chairman Oli and Chief Minister Karki. Even before the agreement to share power in the provinces between the CPN-UML and the Nepali Communist Party (NCP), Koshi's UML lawmakers had launched a signature campaign against Chief Minister Karki in July. Even after a majority vote against Karki and his removal as party leader, the issue reached the party leadership after it became apparent that the Chief Minister's post would not be taken up as the government was formed under Article 168 (5) of the Constitution. Since Chief Minister Karki could not become the new Chief Minister unless he resigned, a discussion was held between Chairman Oli, UML Koshi leadership and Chief Minister Karki to resolve the issue. During the discussion, Chief Minister Karki had said that he would pave the way when the right time came. Now, disgruntled MPs have demanded that Chief Minister Karki resign, saying that the right time has come. There is currently a power equation between the UML and the Nepali Communist Party in Koshi . Although the issue of changing the Chief Minister was moot for some time after the power equation with the Congress ended, it has now resurfaced.

विराटनगर । कोशी प्रदेश सरकारको मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्न नेकपा एमालेभित्रै फेरि चलखेल सुरू भएको छ । मुख्यमन्त्री हिक्मतकुमार कार्कीको स्थानमा तिलकुमार मेन्याङ्बोलाई मुख्यमन्त्री बनाउन एमालेकै असन्तुष्ट प्रदेशसभा सदस्यहरूले दबाब दिन थालेका हुन् । मुख्यमन्त्री कार्की एमाले सचिव तथा कोशी प्रदेश संसदीय दलका नेता हुन् भने मेन्याङ्बो दलका उपनेता हुन् । दलका नेताको स्थानमा उपनेताको नेतृत्वमा सरकार गठन गर्ने विषयमा पार्टी अध्यक्ष केपी शर्मा ओलीसँग समेत कुराकानी भइसकेको छ । मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषयमा दबाब बढाउन असन्तुष्ट सांसदहरूले आज पार्टी अध्यक्ष ओलीलाई भेट्ने तयारी गरेका छन् । पूर्वमन्त्रीसमेत रहेका प्रदेशसभा सदस्य एकराज कार्कीले अध्यक्ष ओलीसँग भेट्न समय मागिएको जानकारी दिँदै कोशीको समसामयिक विषयमा कुराकानी गरिने बताए । यसअघि असन्तुष्ट प्रदेशसभा सदस्यहरूले मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषयमा पार्टीका कोशी प्रदेश अध्यक्ष घनश्याम खतिवडा र प्रदेश इन्चार्ज शेरधन राईसमक्ष दबाब बढाएपछि उनीहरूले अध्यक्ष ओलीसँग यसै विषयमा संवाद गरेका थिए । भेटमा अध्यक्ष ओलीले यसअघिको वाचाअनुसार मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले सहज अवतरण गरिदिनुपर्ने बताएका थिए । भेटमा सहभागी एक नेताले अध्यक्ष ओलीलाई उद्धृत गर्दै भने, ‘हिक्मतजीले यसअघि नै मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्छु भनेकाले उहाँले बाटो खोलिदिनुहुन्छ । उहाँले गर्नुभएन भने म कुरा गर्छु ।’ तर, कहिलेसम्ममा मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्ने भन्ने समयसीमाबारे भने अध्यक्ष ओलीले केही नखुलाएको ती नेताले बताए । अध्यक्ष ओली र मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीबीच कुराकानी भएपछि मात्र यस विषयमा थप स्पष्ट हुने उनको भनाइ छ । नेकपा एमाले र नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (नेकपा) बिच प्रदेशहरूमा सत्ता साझेदारी गर्ने सहमति हुनुअघि नै गएको साउनमा कोशीका एमाले सांसदहरूले मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीविरुद्ध हस्ताक्षर अभियान सञ्चालन गरेका थिए । कार्कीविरुद्ध बहुमत पुर्‍याएर दलको नेताबाट हटाए पनि संविधानको धारा १६८ (५) अन्तर्गत गठन भएको सरकार भएकाले मुख्यमन्त्रीको पद नजाने अवस्था देखिएपछि उक्त विषय पार्टी नेतृत्वसमक्ष पुगेको थियो । मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले राजीनामा नदिएसम्म नयाँ मुख्यमन्त्री बन्न नसक्ने भएपछि सो विषय टुङ्गो लगाउन अध्यक्ष ओली, एमाले कोशी नेतृत्व र मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीबिच छलफल भएको थियो । उक्त छलफलमा मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले उपयुक्त समय आएपछि आफूले मार्ग प्रशस्त गर्ने बताएका थिए । अहिले असन्तुष्ट सांसदहरूले उपयुक्त समय आइसकेको भन्दै मुख्यमन्त्री कार्कीले राजीनामा दिनुपर्ने माग गरेका छन् । कोशीमा हाल एमाले र नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टीबिच सत्ता समीकरण छ । कांग्रेससँगको सत्ता समीकरण सकिएपछि मुख्यमन्त्री फेर्ने विषय केही समय सामसुम भएको भए पनि अहिले पुनः बल्झिएको हो ।

Biratnagar. The movement to change the Chief Minister of the Koshi Province government has begun again within the CPN-UML. Dissatisfied members of the UML's provincial assembly have started pressuring Til Kumar Menyangbo to replace Chief Minister Hikmat Kumar Karki. Chief Minister Karki is the UML secretary and leader of the Koshi Province parliamentary party, while Menyangbo is the deputy leader of the party. Discussions have also been held with party chairman KP Sharma Oli regarding forming a government under the leadership of the deputy leader in place of the party leader. Dissatisfied lawmakers are preparing to meet party chairman Oli today to increase pressure on changing the Chief Minister. Ekraj Karki, a member of the Provincial Assembly and a former minister, informed that he has requested time to meet Chairman Oli and said that they will discuss current issues in Koshi. Earlier, after disgruntled provincial assembly members increased pressure on the party's Koshi Province President Ghanshyam Khatiwada and Province In-charge Sherdhan Rai to change the Chief Minister, they had held talks with Chairman Oli on the issue. During the meeting, Chairman Oli had said that Chief Minister Karki should make a smooth landing as promised earlier. A leader who participated in the meeting quoted Chairman Oli as saying, "Hikmatji has already said he will pave the way, so he will pave the way. If he doesn't, I will talk." However, the leader said that Chairman Oli has not revealed anything about the timeframe for paving the road. He said that more clarity on this issue will be available only after a conversation between Chairman Oli and Chief Minister Karki. Even before the agreement to share power in the provinces between the CPN-UML and the Nepali Communist Party (NCP), Koshi's UML lawmakers had launched a signature campaign against Chief Minister Karki in July. Even after a majority vote against Karki and his removal as party leader, the issue reached the party leadership after it became apparent that the Chief Minister's post would not be taken up as the government was formed under Article 168 (5) of the Constitution. Since Chief Minister Karki could not become the new Chief Minister unless he resigned, a discussion was held between Chairman Oli, UML Koshi leadership and Chief Minister Karki to resolve the issue. During the discussion, Chief Minister Karki had said that he would pave the way when the right time came. Now, disgruntled MPs have demanded that Chief Minister Karki resign, saying that the right time has come. There is currently a power equation between the UML and the Nepali Communist Party in Koshi . Although the issue of changing the Chief Minister was moot for some time after the power equation with the Congress ended, it has now resurfaced.
